title: Glassmorphism & Frosted Glass Design Guidelines
keyTechniques: Use translucent background colors using rgba() or hsla() with 5% to 15% opacity
Apply CSS backdrop-filter: blur(12px) to achieve the frosted glass effect, along with -webkit-backdrop-filter fallback
Include a subtle 1px semi-transparent border (e.g., rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) to define component edges and create depth
Use soft drop shadows (box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.37)) to elevate glass cards above background gradients
avoid: Do not use 100% opaque solid background colors on glass components
Do not omit vendor prefixes for backdrop-filter
Do not use dark opaque borders that break the translucent glass aesthetics
